title: Guesswork starts at version 0.1.0, and Design Thinking keeps version 2.1.1

resolution.decision: Guesswork launches as 3.0.0, continuing the repository's v2 release tags
resolution.note: Existing v2.0.0 to v2.1.1 tags from Design Thinking would make a 0.1.0 release look older and leave @v2 without the Action. The owner went ahead with the 3.0.0 plan.

history.note: Owner delegated this call ("you decide what is best"). Low stakes and cheap to change later; kept as built.
